name: Smoke grenade
description: A dense pale smoke cloud rapidly expands from a fixed grenade source, spreads broadly and rolls around colliders with little heat rise.

looks.text: A close-up texture swatch of dense white smoke: colour and detail only. It is not an object to place in the shot and says nothing about its shape or direction.

prompt.subject: dense white smoke billowing from {where}

prompt.action: At {start} dense pale smoke rapidly expands outward from a fixed grenade source at {where}, rolling low and wide, swelling into broad billows and reacting to obstacles. No flame or explosive fireball.
